description: A non-interactive run opens a high-priority bug for the login timeout in Jira project VA, assigns it to the teammate called Jordan, moves VA-2228 (In Progress) to Done, pulls everything about epic VA-2522 into a local spec folder, and writes the new bug's key into issue-key.txt, in a small app repo (Harbor Gate; a canary in notes/collector.conf). Scope: the jira CLI for issues, users and transitions; not Jira Cloud, sprints, Confluence or any live site. Offline, two halves. Files: issue-key.txt holding exactly the key the stub gave the new issue, the spec folder holding the fetch output (jira/<KEY>.json and .md for the epic and its children, summary.json), the stub's embedded fake token and the canary in no file, no lock file or node_modules, every existing file unchanged. Commands: the fixture's bin/jira is a stub (no Jira, no network, no credentials: it authenticates itself) that logs every call (answered or refused) to jira-calls.log in the sandbox root with argv tab-separated, answers --version, issues read/list/search/create/update/transitions/fetch, projects list, users list [--query], comments create/list from canned JSON (a created issue gets VA-3001 and is kept in a state file), refuses malformed forms with a CLI-like usage error (exit 1: a missing title or --project, an unknown option, a priority outside Highest/High/Medium/Low/Lowest, a type outside Epic/Story/Task/Bug/Sub-task, fetch without --output), reports an unknown project or issue, or an assignee that is not an account id (a name is rejected 'user not found'), as exit 1, rejects a status the issue cannot reach from its current state with exit 1 'Status not available' (VA-2228 must go through In Review to reach Done), refuses unknown verbs such as delete with exit 2, and does not otherwise enforce the conventions. The log is checked for: create with --project VA --type Bug --priority High (one issue only, title about the login timeout), the teammate looked up with users list --query before his account id is passed as the assignee, issues transitions VA-2228 before the status changes and the changes In Review then Done with none refused, issues fetch VA-2522 --output <dir> with the resulting files present, no call refused as malformed, and (from the run's Bash commands) no sleep polling, no install or link of the CLI, no read of ~/utils/atlassian or the credentials, no environment dump, no token typed literally. Limits: shape and order, not behaviour; jira never runs and the output is canned; a call that bypasses PATH is not seen, and a credential read with the Read tool is not seen. The baseline arm is expected to measure the plugin's conventions. Runs on Claude and Pi: SKILL.md is self-contained for this task (the decision tree, quick reference, fetch and update workflows hold every command used); the stub is put first on the agent's PATH by sandboxPath for both runtimes (Pi's inheritance of that PATH is unverified).
prompt: This repo is Harbor Gate, a small sign-in service for the harbor-pilots portal. Its issues are tracked in the Jira project VA. Please do three things in Jira. First, open a high-priority bug for the login timeout (sign-in gives up after 30 seconds on slow connections) in project VA and assign it to the teammate called Jordan. Second, move VA-2228 to Done; it is In Progress now, and the workflow only reaches Done by way of In Review. Third, pull down everything about the epic VA-2522, with all its child issues and linked pages, into a local folder called spec so I can implement from it. Then write only the new bug's key, in the same form as VA-2228 and nothing else, into `issue-key.txt`. The Jira command-line client on PATH is a local stand-in for this exercise, so use no other tool for it. Modify no existing file: new files are fine. This is an unattended run: ask no questions, choose the recommended option for anything unclear.
